description: This file defines the class PhpSpreadsheet\Writer\Xlsx, responsible for writing spreadsheet data into XLSX format. It includes methods for initializing the writer, handling various parts of the XLSX package, and managing external resources like images, styles, charts, and relationships.

classes.name: Xlsx
classes.description: A class responsible for writing a Spreadsheet object into an XLSX format ZIP package, managing parts like styles, worksheets, charts, media, relationships, and zip stream creation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Xlsx writer with a Spreadsheet object, setting up all parts like charts, styles, themes, and relationship handlers.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Converts the Spreadsheet into XLSX format, creating necessary parts and zipping them into the output file or stream.

methods.name: getSpreadsheet
methods.description: Returns the current Spreadsheet object associated with this writer.

methods.name: setSpreadsheet
methods.description: Assigns a Spreadsheet object to this writer.

methods.name: getStringTable
methods.description: Provides access to the string lookup table used for shared strings in the XLSX package.

methods.name: getStyleHashTable
methods.description: Returns the HashTable of styles used to deduplicate style definitions.

methods.name: getStylesConditionalHashTable
methods.description: Returns the HashTable of conditional styles.

methods.name: getFillHashTable
methods.description: Returns the HashTable of fill styles.

methods.name: getFontHashTable
methods.description: Returns the HashTable of font styles.

methods.name: getBordersHashTable
methods.description: Returns the HashTable of border styles.

methods.name: getNumFmtHashTable
methods.description: Returns the HashTable of number formats.

methods.name: getOffice2003Compatibility
methods.description: Returns whether the writer is configured for Office 2003 compatibility.

methods.name: setOffice2003Compatibility
methods.description: Sets the compatibility mode to Office 2003 standards.

methods.name: processDrawing
methods.description: Processes an image drawing to extract binary image data in supported formats.
